title: Inner product with a finite probability expectation
statement: Let $\Xi$ be a finite set, let $V$ be a real inner product space, let $\mu$ be a probability mass function on $\Xi$, let $v\in V$, and let $g:\Xi\to V$. The inner product of $v$ with the expectation of $g$ under $\mu$ equals the scalar expectation of the inner products: $\langle v,\mathbb E_\mu[g]\rangle=\mathbb E_\mu[\langle v,g\rangle]$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a real inner product space
$\mu$ is a probability mass function on $\Xi$
